title: Simple Orbital Strike Mod
description: Fishing rods that call orbital strikes. Two shot types, works in survival and creative.
body:
## Thank you everyone for 10k downloads!

Right-click a fishing rod made with this mod and call down an orbital strike on the block you're aiming at.

There are two kinds.

**stab shot** rains TNT down through every solid block in the column under the target. Drills straight through mountains.

**nuke shot** spawns a wide ring of TNT high above the target. The TNT fans outward as it falls, then detonates.

## Crafting

stab shot: a fishing rod with TNT in the up, down, left, and right slots.

nuke shot: a fishing rod surrounded by TNT in all eight slots around it.

Each TNT slot needs 32 TNT by default. You can lower or increase this in the config.

## In-game config

On Fabric you can edit every setting from inside the game. Open Mods, pick Simple Orbital Strike, click the gear icon. You need Mod Menu installed for the gear to show up.

What you can change:

- explosion power
- nuke radius and ring layout
- extra knockback force
- TNT fuse and spawn height
- delay before the strike fires
- op level needed for `/orbitalstrike`
- TNT count required per crafting slot

NeoForge ships with the same defaults. A built-in NeoForge config screen is coming in v1.0.8.

## Loaders

Fabric, Quilt, and NeoForge.
